fusions.name: Bitter Dose
fusions.desc: You hop up to 4 tiles to the target and strike with your weapon for 6 poison damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Last Drop
fusions.desc: A bite on an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Drawn Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, heals you for 10 health, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Immune Carrier
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
